title: FROM BALLON D'OR TO 140 HORSES: OWEN SAYS ISAK IS 'A YARD OFF'
description:
Ballon d'Or winner, pundit, stable boss. Michael Owen has been busy.

Michael Owen beat Raul to the Ballon d'Or in 2001, 176 votes to 140, aged 22. Now he's the one telling everyone what they're doing wrong. Isak is running out of excuses, he says, a yard off the pace, and Liverpool need a return on about 125 million pounds. Expensive yard.

Away from the pitch, Owen runs Manor House Stables, with about 140 horses in training. Two of his Bahrain runners finished eighth and tenth of 13, and trainer Hugo Palmer says they'll go again. He says he'll never play football again, yet he says his Ballon d'Or means more now. The stable has no golden ball yet.
